test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 1 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following sultans of the Delhi Sultanate controlled the prices of market goods during his reign?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alauddin Khilji**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alauddin Khilji**

 
 
• **Emperor Alauddin Ghilji **presided over the **Delhi Sultanate **in the **Indian subcontinent **as **a member of the Khalji dynasty**.
 
• **Significant administrative changes **were **implemented by Alauddin **in the **areas of revenues, price controls, and society**.
 
• His **region was from 19 July 1296 to 4 January 1316**.
 
• He **died in January 1316, in Delhi**.
 
• According to a **Hindu inscription found **in the **Udaipur region, Ghiyath al-din Khalji **was **defeated **in **combat in 1488 **by **Badal-Gora, **a Rajput leader who Jaisi had multiplied into twins.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sultan Abu Bakr Shah **was a **Muslim ruler **of the **Tughlaq dynasty**. He was the **son of Zafar Khan **and the **grandson of Sultan Feroze Shah Tughluq**.
 
• Soon after **Timur's invasion **and the **fall of the Tughlaq dynasty **in northern India, **Sayyid Khizr Khan founded the Sayyid dynasty**, which later **became the governing dynasty of the Delhi sultanate**. Firuz Shah Tughlaq appointed Khan as governor of Multan, and he was a renowned administrator.
 
• **Qutb-ud-din In modern-**day India, the **Delhi Sultanate was ruled by Mubarak Shah**. He was a **descendant of Alauddin Khalji **and a member of the **Khalji dynasty**. Following **Alauddin's passing**, Malik Kafur imprisoned Mubarak Shah and installed his younger brother Shihabuddin Omar as puppet king.
